cinematic.aetheria.adventure.line1: A thousand years ago, a rain of stars fell upon this world.

cinematic.aetheria.adventure.line3: To guard them, the ancients forged a warden: Valerius.
cinematic.aetheria.adventure.line4: But the guardian has fallen. Now his runes devour the sky.
